source.title: GSHHG full-resolution binary, release 2.3.7
source.license: LGPLv3 or later; license retained at data/macro-improvements/macro-coverage-oceania/gshhg-LGPL.txt
source.restore: Download the pinned archive, verify archive SHA-256, extract gshhs_f.b and verify member SHA-256.

method.selection: For every pinned assigned location, bbox-index full-resolution level-1 physical land records, calculate each candidate ring vertex centroid, and ray-crossing test that point against all bbox-compatible assigned polygons, respecting current holes. Retain complete matched GSHHG records only.
method.interpretation: Two distinct screens are reported: (1) source land-polygon centroid within a current assigned polygon; (2) each pinned source representative point lies within a GSHHG level-1 land polygon. Either point test is screening only; it does not establish whole-boundary agreement, component containment, island identity, named-land completeness, or settlement coverage. A no-hit does not prove omitted land. Physical source is independent of political ownership and current administrative status.
